_leia: Pedidos dos símbolos pintados dos 'Bons momentos' do fim da partida (shared/regras.js chama momento(j, p, símbolo, texto)). Gere com: python3 tools/arte_icones.py --pedidos arte/momentos.json [ids...]. Sem referência: vão só com o texto. Saída: arte/fonte/momentos/<id>.png e js/momentos_pintados.js (window.MOMENTOS_PINTADOS); o jogo troca o símbolo de texto pelo pintado (MOMENTO_ID em js/jogo.js). O '☕' (sem lances) usa o retrato pintado da xícara. Os de "furos" (a boia) têm o miolo aberto (transparente) na hora de embutir.
estilo: Dice Duel game achievement icon: a cozy flat sticker illustration of ONE single object, like a polished vector game icon. Thick uniform dark cocoa outline (#3a2a2e) around the whole silhouette and every shape, flat color fills with only one soft cel-shaded shadow tone and one small highlight per shape, no painterly brush texture, no gradients, no noise, no 3D rendering. Palette of the game: warm cream #fbf1df, ivory #fffaf0, sage green #5f8f78, wood brown #a86c45, honey #f2b15e, dark honey #c4843a, coral #e8806f, rose #ec8fa8, sky blue #6fbfd3, lavender #b8a4f0, mint #8fd6a8. VERY simple, bold, chunky silhouette with few large shapes and no small details, so it stays instantly readable at 24 pixels wide; the object fills most of the canvas, centered, straight front view. Around the dark outline, one even thin cream (#fbf1df) sticker border following the silhouette. No text, no letters, no numbers, no frame, no card, no badge background, no drop shadow on the ground, plain transparent background.

itens.virada: A honey-gold (#f2b15e) crescent moon with one small cream star beside it, meaning a comeback: the player was far behind and turned the game around.
itens.sinfonia: A big plump five-pointed gold star (#f2b15e, dark honey #c4843a shadow) with a small dark music note cut in its center, meaning a symphony: a full chain of six dice.
itens.harmonia: A round five-petal flower with rose-pink petals (#ec8fa8) and a honey center, two small sage-green leaves, meaning harmony: every link of the chain in the same relation.
itens.truque: Only one big four-pointed lavender (#b8a4f0) magic sparkle star with concave sides, plus one tiny cream sparkle next to it, meaning a clever trick. Draw ONLY the sparkles: no dice, no cards, no other objects.
itens.salvou: A coral (#e8806f) and cream striped life ring buoy, meaning the chain was saved.
itens.esquiva: Only one very thick sky-blue (#6fbfd3) curved arrow making a U-turn swerve, like a dodge swoosh, with a dark sky-blue shadow side. Draw ONLY the arrow: no dice, no other objects.
itens.bloqueio: A sturdy round wooden shield (#a86c45) with a honey metal rim and a central boss, meaning a block or defense.
itens.nota: A single chunky eighth music note in dark cocoa with a honey highlight, meaning a five-dice chain.
itens.recorde: A round gold medal (#f2b15e) with a rose (#ec8fa8) V-shaped ribbon on top and a small star embossed in the center, meaning a new personal record.
